references.text: God promises Joshua that He will be with him just as He was with Moses; the same promise is repeated here.
The fulfillment of the promise in 3:7 - The Lord exalted Joshua in the eyes of all Israel.
Israel feared the Lord and believed in Moses after crossing the Red Sea, a parallel to Joshua's exaltation at the Jordan.
Moses was commanded to give Joshua part of his honor so that all Israel would obey him.
Moses encourages Joshua and assures him of the Lord's presence.
The Lord commands Joshua to be strong and courageous and promises to be with him.
The Lord was with Samuel and let none of his words fall to the ground, a similar confirmation of God's presence.
Solomon's servants ask that the Lord may be with him just as He was with David.
